name: Shima Mayuri
source:
The nurse in charge of ‘healing services’. She has only recently started working at the ‘Sasaoyama Clinic’, the setting of the story, and the protagonist becomes her first ‘assigned patient’.

She has a gentle disposition and is kind to everyone. She is somewhat naive and easily deceived. In particular, her knowledge of sexual matters is lacking.

As a nurse, she performs her duties reliably, though her slow pace is a drawback. This led her to quit her previous hospital job because she couldn't keep up with the work speed.

Still unable to abandon her desire to work as a nurse, she was invited by her nursing school senior, Ryouka, to work at this hospital.

She is a virgin and, having attended an all-girls school, has never dated a man. Because of this, she initially acts somewhat timid around the protagonist.

She works meticulously but struggles with casual conversation. She can interact normally with him as a “patient,” but becomes flustered when she consciously thinks of him as a “man.”

However, as her affection grows, she gradually opens up. If you become closer, she will offer her virginity.

Her specialty is cooking, covering Japanese, Western, and Chinese cuisine. She likes bringing well prepared homemade bento lunches.

Her ‘service’ style leans toward affectionate, soothing, or lover-like atmospheres. She always shows shyness and hesitation during intimate moments.

Though inexperienced, she strives earnestly and devotedly to please. As the protagonist explores her, she gradually discovers feminine pleasures.

[From [url=https://www.ume.gr.jp/product/ume/hakui_g/hakui_g.html]official site[/url]]
